name: trace_query_tool
description: Query the current session's agent trace jsonl without writing probe scripts: tool-call distribution, file-write locations (outputs/ pollution check), failed calls, multiline-bash suspects, bash-substitutability ratio, per-round call sequence. Args: query = '<sub> [--trace <session-id>] [--round N]'; sub in summary|toolmix|writes|errors|multiline|calls|substitutability; --trace omitted means the latest .jsonl in the traces dir.
